title: Cleaner, truer heroes
text:
No more stretching or smearing on the hero models, swords carried at the side, and a more upright, natural stride.

🔧 No more dragging or smearing when heroes move their arms: arms, hands, weapons and wings are now cut free of the body wherever they touched it, so they move cleanly instead of stretching the skin
🔧 Legs move cleanly too: boots stay on the feet, and coats and robes no longer smear between the legs when running
⬆️ The Celestus and the Bard now carry their swords at their right side, the blade hanging naturally, with the other arm relaxed, instead of holding them out in front with both hands
✨ The Celestus and the Bard fight one-handed: a forehand cut, a backhand return and an overhead chop, with the free hand balancing
✨ Heroes have wrists: weapons turn in the hand as they swing, and stay pointing the right way while running
⬆️ A more upright, natural stance and stride: heroes no longer lean far forward when moving, only a few degrees into a run, with the head held level
⬆️ Each blow now steps into the strike, and the arms move freely with the body in every attack, cast and emote
